_comment: Per-model metadata for report/dashboard/index 'arm cards'. Keyed by the llama-router section id (== the model id used in backends.json modelName for single arms, and in levels.yaml roles for team arms). family=vendor family, params=human param string, quant=GGUF quant, note=one-line best-use. Arm kind (single vs team) and team role-makeup are DERIVED at render time from backends.json (endpoint :8077=single router, :8080=hub team) + targets/med-agent-hub/server/levels.yaml (team roles) — not stored here. Grounded from scripts/llama-router.ini, the .lmstudio GGUF paths, and observed file sizes; verify quant against the actual GGUF if precision matters.

families.Gemma 4: Google general-purpose open model — Unified encoder-free multimodal, 256K context, reasoning + tool-use
families.IBM Granite: IBM enterprise open model — tuned for RAG, extraction, tool-use, and safety
families.MedGemma: Google Gemma fine-tuned on medical data — the team's clinical specialist
families.Liquid LFM2: Liquid AI on-device hybrid model — fast, agentic/tool-use, weak on knowledge-heavy tasks, no medical training
families.Liquid LFM2.5: Liquid AI on-device hybrid model (newer) — instruction-following + tool-calling

gemma-4-12b.note: strong + safe general single model (Gemma 4 12B Instruct, ~Q8) — the prior top single

gemma-4-12b-q4.note: quant control — same Gemma 4 12B Instruct at Q4 vs the Q8 gemma-4-12b

mistral-nemo-12b.note: general single; 128K context, strong instruction-following + structured output

qwen3.6-35b.note: thinking/reasoning single — tests whether reasoning (not knowledge) lifts grounded extraction

mistral-nemo-12b-q8.note: Q8 tier — Mistral NeMo matched up to Gemma's precision

qwen3-14b-q8.note: Q8 tier — Qwen3-14B (non-thinking) matched up to Gemma's precision

granite-3.3-8b-q8.note: Q8 tier — Granite matched up to Gemma's precision

qwen2.5-14b-q8.note: Q8 tier — Qwen2.5-14B matched up to Gemma's precision

lfm2-24b-a2b.note: fast agentic writer; no medical/reasoning focus

lfm2-8b-a1b.note: most capable general Liquid; no medical training

lfm2-2.6b.note: strong small dense; tool-use/instruction-following — robust coordinator
